## **Errores y estabilidad** {#theme-bugs_stability}

<!--ir-theme:bugs_stability-->
   **Errores y estabilidad.**
      4 reseñas recientes mencionan errores y estabilidad.
      Ventana de reseñas: 23 jul 2026 - 10 oct 2026
      **Por qué importa:** Los usuarios mencionan crashes o inestabilidad. Trátalo como accionable solo si el volumen sube o sigue a una update; si no, suele ser ruido baseline.

         **Ejemplos de reseñas:**
            1. _Kathryn17*_, 10 oct 2026, 1/5: "After four months of hoping the app redesign would be rectified, I am writing to discourage anyone who is about to pay for premium — as I did shortly before the redesign ruined what had been an outstanding app. Every update brings new features that are annoying, like the confetti with almost every entry that continues despite numerous complaints (mine included). This week’s update added a link to a “tip” where the swipe function had been, no way to bypass it. To make sure I hadn’t missed some miraculous design improvements, I scrolled through the recent reviews. For longtime members (like me, since 2014), the comments are overwhelmingly negative. Once again I have sent an email to customer service that will likely generate another meaningless response. I will never be a paid subscriber again. I am writing again to say I cannot believe that this app could get worse, but the latest update is making it unusable. I’m getting constant “atta boys” when I log something. I am not five years old! And when I log from my list I have to scroll to return to where I selected an item to log. I just can’t believe that you care so little about all these customers, many of them for 10+ years like me, who are furious that you refuse to FIX THIS. If it were free I would simply walk away, but when I requested a refund I got a warning that all my data could be lost. I am furious but no one at MFP seems to care."
            2. _LoriLins64_, 16 ago 2026, 1/5: "Note: I am a paid user, and have been using MFP for a couple of years now, quite happily. But this new update is absolutely horrific, the worst I’ve ever seen. They took a very user-friendly app and made it ridiculously unusable. What used to be very simple is now a frustrating exercise and having to navigate through many screens and not being able to even see your macros, or how many you have left. I actually hate it. I wish there was a way to refer to the previous version. As soon as I find a replacement, I will be canceling my subscription and deleting this monstrosity from my phone."
            3. _Anne Dlh_, 23 jul 2026, 1/5: "L’application bug dès la première utilisation. Je ne vous recommande pas d’utiliser une application qui vous indique de consommé que 1400 kCal par jour pour une femme… Vous obtiendrez l’inverse de votre objectif. Vous allez perturber votre corps et votre santé mentale. Et pour certaines, développer des TCA… Bien tenté mais non merci."
<!--/ir-theme-->
